#### Quest log

**Cyno:** What's wrong with it? Even the doctors at Dar al-Shifa allow patients to be accompanied by family members.

Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.

#### Talk to Katheryne

**Katheryne:** Ah, Traveler, Paimon. It's been a while.

**Katheryne:** As it happens, there is a letter here for you. One moment... Here.

**Paimon:** A letter? From who?

**Collei:** (Dear diary, I'm Collei. I work as a trainee Forest Ranger under my master, Tighnari. I'm also studying at the Akademiya.)

**Collei:** (I've been getting better and better at reading lately. Mr. Alhaitham says that the written word is a crucial medium for exploring the world and understanding oneself. That's why I decided to start this diary...)

**Collei:** (That said, what should I write about? Things are pretty quiet in Sumeru these days. Life is good. Every day is a fulfilling and happy one.)

**Collei:** (When I think back to the days when I suffered from Eleazar, or way back to when I was injected with god remains... I'm in a much better place now. I hope it stays that way forever.)

**Collei:** (I'll leave it there for now. Master said he'll take me shopping in Sumeru City today, which is great, because I've been meaning to visit the toy seller at the Grand Bazaar for a while now...)

**Sethos:** Collei, time to go!

**Collei:** Yes, Master... Huh!?

#### Discuss the current situation with Sethos

**Forest Watcher:** What's wrong, Collei? Is there something on my face...?

**Collei:** N—No, sorry — I didn't mean to stare. Did Master Tighnari send you to pick me up?

**Forest Watcher:** "Master Tighnari"? Haha, what are you talking about?

**Forest Watcher:** Tighnari is the General Mahamatra. He's probably busy arresting criminals in Sumeru City... Heh, I mean, if that's what floats your boat, I can introduce you, but...

**Collei:** Wait, Master Tighnari is the General Mahamatra? But what about Mr. Cyno?

**Forest Watcher:** Sorry?

**Forest Watcher:** Oh oh oh, you mean that guy who just joined the Vahumana Darshan? Rumor has it he's the leader of the Temple of Silence. If that's true, it's pretty impressive.

**Forest Watcher:** Sounds like you've been getting to know more and more people since you joined the Akademiya. That's great, but don't let your Forest Ranger duties fall by the wayside, okay?

**Collei:** (What's going on? Sethos is acting like he's my master, and Master Tighnari has taken over Mr. Cyno's job. Is this some kind of prank?)

**Collei:** (If so, it's a weird choice of prank... But anyway, Sethos doesn't look like he's joking. What is this all about?)

**Forest Watcher:** Hey, you're zoning out again. I'm gonna buy some tools for the rangers. Why don't you stretch your legs a bit? It's been a while since you last visited the city, right?

**Collei:** Wait...

**Collei:** (He's right... It has been a while since I last visited Sumeru City. Was it always like this? I mean, it feels familiar, yet somehow... Something seems different...)

**Collei:** (Is this really Sumeru City...?)

#### Explore Sumeru City

**Qasimi:** Lord Kaveh Bay, did you get a chance to review this month's accounts? Any feedback?

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Yawn... You mean, the version you sent over a few days ago? Yeah, I took a look when I received it.

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** I was thinking that maybe our profit margin is a little excessive? I visited some of our commercial partners last month. Their earnings are very slim.

**Qasimi:** Are you suggesting that we give up some of our profits for them?

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Well, since we have more than we need, yes. Making money for its own sake is pointless. Don't worry, I've already planned for it, and the numbers look fine. We can adjust the rates starting from next month.

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Also, about that designer you hired... I've had to revise his proposal three times now, but he just doesn't seem to.... *sigh*

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Let's cut our losses. Pay him his fee and send him on his way. I'd like you to get Layla on this instead. She was Cyrus's student and she designed the Palace of Alcazarzaray. Seems like a much safer choice...

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Hmm? Who's sneaking around over there?

**Collei:** ...Mr. Kaveh?

**Hisham:** Do you recognize this person, Sir?

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Yes, it's alright, We've met. This is Collei, Sethos's trainee. He brought her along the last time I went for drinks with him.

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** What brings you to the city, Collei? Is your master here too?

**Collei:** (No, no, this is all wrong! Why is Mr. Kaveh saying that too? Tighnari's my master, not Sethos!)

**Collei:** (This can't be real... I have to ask someone else. There's gotta be someone else out there who still remembers the truth!)

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** ...Hey, wait, don't run off! How strange... What's gotten into her today?

**Akram:** Hey, did you see who just walked by? I think she's that famous merc...

**Farooq:** Yeah, it's gotta be her. That red hair gives her away — the "Flame-Mane"... They say she can take down a dozen tough guys with just one hand!

**Nizam:** Would you like some fruit?

**Tanamart:** How will I ever save enough money to buy that custom-made axe with floral carvings from the blacksmith?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What do you need that for?

**Tanamart:** To use as a weapon, of course.

**Tanamart:** As Housein's secretary, I must ensure his safety. Don't underestimate me just because I'm a homemaker. I used to be a mercenary in the Corps of Thirty.

**Tanamart:** Peace is precious, but you must always be prepared for the worst.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** See you.

**Tanamart:** See you. Whether you're at home or heading out, make sure you stay safe.

**Housein:** It takes courage to maintain a peaceful life too.

**Housein:** Hello, my name is Housein. I'm responsible for managing administrative affairs in the Grand Bazaar and Treasures Street on behalf of the Akademiya.

**Housein:** It's always one thing after another... *sigh* If only everyone was as good-natured as the great merchant Kaveh Bay.

**Nawid:** When I grow up, I'm gonna join the Eremites and protect Sumeru City!

**Rima:** I heard that the sage disappears without a trace as soon as he gets off work. It's a little mysterious if you ask me...

#### Explore Sumeru City

**Mahamata at the Exchange:** Lots of visitors today, I see! Welcome, all, it's been a while.

**Dehya:** Hey, Rahman. You know that guy who sells face powder on Treasures Street? I haven't seen him around in a while. Any idea what happened to him?

**Mahamata at the Exchange:** Oh, you mean Ahangar? Yeah, he got into a brawl with Shevirme on Treasures Street... He's been banned from setting up shop there for now.

**Dehya:** Seriously? Well, that's a shame. I was planning to pick out some makeup for you...

**Nilou:** Oh, don't worry about it.

**Mahamata at the Exchange:** The legendary "Flame-Mane" discussing makeup with the Zubayr Theater's star dancer... Haha. Now there's something you don't see every day.

**Nilou:** Flame-Mane...

**Flame-Mane:** You know, I'm not actually sure when people started calling me that. Maybe the other Eremites thought I needed a fiercer title to scare people off?

**Flame-Mane:** To be completely honest, I think the title would fit you better than me, Dehya.

**Principal Dancer:** You think? Haha, can't say I've never imagined myself as a merc. If I ever give up the dancing, maybe I'll head to the desert and give the Eremite life a try.

**Flame-Mane:** You would?

**Principal Dancer:** Is that so strange?

**Flame-Mane:** Oh, not at all. In fact, I've actually had similar thoughts before... If I ever get tired of sleeping out in the wild, I think I might go look for a job at the Zubayr Theater.

**Flame-Mane:** I've adored the Dance of Sabzeruz ever since the first time I saw you perform it. If the chance ever came up, I'd love to try it out on stage for myself.

**Principal Dancer:** Really? If our manager, Setaria heard you say that, she'd hold you to it. Probably grab you by the sleeve and never let you go again.

**Principal Dancer:** Hey, when that day comes, I'll do your makeup myself. How's that sound?

**Flame-Mane:** Sure! If the day comes, I'd be honored.

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** *sigh* Remember a while back when I was working on a renovation plan for the House of Daena? Well, I submitted a report to the Grand Sage, and he rejected it!

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** It's infuriating! How does someone with no sense of aesthetics whatsoever even become the Grand Sage?

**Qasimi:** Please, calm down, Lord Kaveh. Maybe it's for the best that the proposal wasn't approved. Weren't you planning on paying for the renovations out of your own pocket? The Grand Sage just saved you a huge sum of Mora.

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** ...You're right. It's his loss if he doesn't want to work with me. Let him live out the rest of his days in an artless void for all I care! Hmph!

**Super Wealthy Merchant Who Has It All:** Anyway, enough about that killjoy. There's supposed to be a show at the Zubayr Theater today. Are you guys free later? Tickets are on me if you want to join.

**Researcher:** The Grand Sage always used to disappear the moment he got off work. But recently, for whatever reason, he's been seen sifting through records in the House of Daena late into the night.

**Researcher:** We asked him if there was anything unusual going on, but he answered us with a question of his own: "Don't you find it strange that someone with my personality would willingly accept the position of sage?"

**Zohreh:** Hey bud, can I ask you a favor? Is it alright if I borrow your thesis?

**Zohreh:** Don't worry, I'm not gonna copy your work. I just need it as a reference.

**Sanad:** I guess that's okay... but if our theses end up sounding too similar, it's gonna be easy for them to spot.

**Zohreh:** Yeah, trust me, plagiarism's the last thing on my mind. The only reason I ask is, it's been really hard to get my hands on any reference material lately...

**Sanad:** Why don't you go ask the Grand Conservator? Candace should be able to find you what you need. She's super friendly, I'm sure she'll be happy to help.

**Zohreh:** Really? I always assumed she'd be tough to negotiate with... Fair enough. I'll try my luck at the House of Daena later, then.

**Acting Manager of Puspa Café:** Would you like a cup of coffee?

**Acting Manager of Puspa Café:** The store's been pretty busy lately. Lots of customers have been feeding Ashru, who watches over the shop, and now Ashru's put on quite a lot of weight... Maybe I should put up a sign saying "Please Don't Feed the Cat"?

**Alrani:** Students are under so much pressure these days. Sometimes, I just want to write their papers for them.

**Alrani:** Peculiar papers come to me for review every day. I really wish they were able to relax once in a while and not be constantly plagued by academic conundrums. It doesn't do a person any good to spend too long down the rabbit hole.

#### Explore Sumeru City

**Ilyas:** Mahamatra Tighnari, we've apprehended the suspect.

**General Mahamatra:** They say that the fool is prone to blind faith, but the wise man is not immune to it either.

**General Mahamatra:** Siraj, do you have anything to say in your defense?

**Siraj:** Tighnari...! You were the one who turned the sages against me! Just a few words of caution from you was all it took to destroy my research!

**Siraj:** And now you're trying to stop me again? You should know that mechanical life is the future. We must cast aside our useless flesh and—

**General Mahamatra:** That's enough. I'm not in the mood to listen to your lunacy. Anyone could tell you how amateur your work is.

**General Mahamatra:** Kareena, Ilyas, put him somewhere safely out of the way.

**Kareena:** ...Yes, sir!

**General Mahamatra:** Next on the agenda is... Hmm?

**Collei:** ...Master?

**General Mahamatra:** What is it? ...Wait, did Professor Zaha Hadi send you? She's been encouraging me to take on an apprentice... Might be getting a bit ahead of herself there, though.

**Collei:** No! Master, it's me! Collei!

**Collei:** Listen to me, something really weird is going on in Sumeru City. It's like everyone's identities have switched around...

**Collei:** You're not the General Mahamatra, you're a Forest Watcher! Just yesterday, we agreed to come to Sumeru City today to go shopping together, and—

**General Mahamatra:** Alright, there's no rush. Let's back up a little.

**General Mahamatra:** Your name is Collei, correct? Although this is our first meeting, you do seem strangely familiar somehow. Is there anything I can help you with?

**Collei:** No, no...

**Collei:** Master, Master...

**Tighnari:** What is it?

**Collei:** Huh?

**Tighnari:** Did you have another nightmare?

**Tighnari:** I've told you before, when you're tired, lay down on your back in bed and get some proper sleep. It's much better for you than napping on your front. Poor posture obstructs your breathing, which can lead to all sorts of weird dreams.

**Tighnari:** Now, we're supposed to go shopping in Sumeru City today, remember? Cheer up, I'll take you to Hushang's. I heard he's got some new toys in stock.

**Tighnari:** Go wash your face, take some deep breaths, and when you're ready, we'll head out.

**Collei:** O—Okay! Thanks, Master Tighnari.

**Collei:** (Huh... So it was just a dream.)

**???:** And yet, dreams can sometimes be a warning of things that will soon come to pass.

**Collei:** Wh—Who who said that!?

**???:** That dream felt unusually real, didn't it? Here's my suggestion... Since you're heading into Sumeru City anyway, you may as well tell Lesser Lord Kusanali about everything that happened.

**???:** And just to be on the safe side, I think you should also inform your two traveler friends who once helped save Sumeru. I'd write them a letter if I were you.

**???:** Time is short... A storm is coming from beyond the bounds of fate.

**Principal Dancer:** Nilou, have you been to Aaru Village recently? I've got a friend who I haven't seen in a while... I was wondering how she's doing.

**Flame-Mane:** You mean Faruzan? The guardian of Aaru Village? I saw her not too long ago. She seemed completely absorbed in her research.

**Principal Dancer:** No change there, then... I'll have to catch up with her the next time I'm out that way.

**Scribe:** Alright, not a single Mora short. That covers you for this month's rent.

**Renowned Architect:** What a relief... I was worried the design fees I received this month wouldn't be enough.

**Scribe:** Well, next time, don't fret — just let me know, and I'll give you a few days' grace. We've known each other long enough for that! Anyway, how are you settling in? I couldn't help but notice that you're staying up late quite often.

**Renowned Architect:** Yeah... I can't explain it, I just feel more inspired at night. Once I get in the zone, I can race through a whole bunch of drafts, no problem.

**Renowned Architect:** But what about you? I keep hearing you sighing these days... Is everything okay?

**Scribe:** Well, it's just... Don't you think this house is a little small?

**Scribe:** I guess I should be used to it after living here for so many years... But for some reason, I've been feeling claustrophobic recently. I want to move somewhere bigger.

**Scribe:** Once I've made enough Mora, I'm going to buy a huge new house, as big as... Uh... At least as big as the Palace of Alcazarzaray!

**Renowned Architect:** That sounds really expensive...

**Scribe:** True. I'll never be able to afford it on a scribe's salary alone. I need to find another way...

**Isak:** Hi, Mr. Cyno. What are you thinking about?

**Keeper of Temple of Silence:** There's a chapter in "King of Invokations" where the spirit of someone who died long ago possesses a living man's body. To the outside world, it looks like he's developed a whole new personality.

**Keeper of Temple of Silence:** I was just thinking how terrifying that would be for his friends. Imagine waking up one day to find that a friend of yours has suddenly become a different person...

**Isak:** Huh... So what got you thinking about that?

**Keeper of Temple of Silence:** I don't know, but something feels off. Everything looks fine on the surface, but... Can human perception really be trusted?

#### Discuss the letter's contents with Paimon

**Paimon:** What a strange situation... No wonder Collei was in such a rush to write us a letter.

**Paimon:** Imagine waking up one day to find that everything around you has changed. You might not even recognize Paimon anymore... Ohh, that's a scary thought!

**Paimon:** Let's get to Sumeru and find out what the heck is going on!

#### Return to Sumeru

#### Enter Sumeru City to check on the situation

**Paimon:** Collei!

**Collei:** Traveler, Paimon! Thank goodness. I'm so glad you made it!

**Paimon:** Of course! We won't let anything happen to you, Collei. So, what's going on in Sumeru City? Looks like lots of people are moving, or something?

**Collei:** Yeah, I was just gonna say.

**Collei:** After I wrote my letter, Master and I went to Sumeru City and told the Dendro Archon everything that I experienced, from start to finish.

- **Traveler:** What did Nahida say?

**Collei:** She was silent at first. It seemed like she was deep in thought... Then, the next day, we got told that she was ordering everyone to leave Sumeru City immediately and move to Caravan Ribat.

**Paimon:** ...The entire population of the city has to move?

**Tighnari:** Not just Sumeru City. The evacuation also includes Lokapala Jungle, Avidya Forest, Ashavan Realm, and Ardravi Valley...

**Tighnari:** Basically, everyone living in the rainforest must temporarily relocate to Caravan Ribat.

**Paimon:** Holy smokes... That's crazy!

**Tighnari:** Yes, it's quite an operation. Even if people only bring the bare essentials, the scale is simply enormous.

**Tighnari:** They've requisitioned almost all the Sumpter Beasts in Sumeru for the task. Including the entirety of Dori's Sumpter Beast Park.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** All on account of that dream Collei had?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Did Nahida give any indication as to why?

##### Shared continuation

**Tighnari:** The Dendro Archon said that what Collei experienced was not a dream, but a warning.

**Tighnari:** After our meeting, she immediately summoned the six sages to analyze the situation and discuss countermeasures. They concluded that the events seen in the dream are very likely to become a reality, and that an unknown danger is rapidly approaching.

**Tighnari:** Oh, uh, please keep that to yourself. We don't want to cause widespread panic.

**Tighnari:** The official reason they've given is a large-scale renovation of the rainforest's ecosystem. People are skeptical, but there haven't been any major incidents. So far, at least.

**Collei:** The Dendro Archon seemed really worried when we spoke to her... She said you can go visit her in the Sanctuary of Surasthana when you arrive.

**Collei:** She also said she'd hold out until the very end.

**Amir:** Tighnari, Collei, you got a minute? I need a hand here...

**Tighnari:** One moment, I'll be right there!

**Tighnari:** As a Forest Watcher, I've been tasked with assisting with the relocation work. There's a lot to be done, and they need all the help they can get.

**Tighnari:** This will be the final group of evacuees from Sumeru City. While they're away from home, they'll be heavily reliant on outside help.

**Tighnari:** Thank you for coming in our time of need. As you can see, another crisis is upon us.

**Aryadeva:** Excuse me... Sorry to trouble you, but could you help an old man find his medicine? It's buried somewhere in my luggage.

**Amid:** Where's my mom? Where did she go? *sob*...

**Amir:** Phew... Don't worry, it'll be okay...

**Hatim:** Those items are worth a small fortune. Make sure you store them somewhere safe, you understand?

**Rima:** I bet you thought you'd get away with this in the chaos, huh? Guess again! No petty thief gets past me.

- **Traveler:** (A mass evacuation inevitably comes with all kinds of problems. Nahida wouldn't have resorted to this unless it was absolutely necessary.)

- **Traveler:** (The strange events of Collei's dream took place in Sumeru City... Whatever danger is afoot, it must start here, which is why everyone has to leave.)

**Tighnari:** We should go help the evacuees. See you around.

**Collei:** Um... I'm so glad that you believed me and came all this way to help. It means a lot. Please stay safe.

**Paimon:** Don't worry! We may not know exactly what's going on yet, but as long as we stick together, we'll find a way through this!

**Paimon:** Goodbye! Look after yourselves!

**Collei:** Will do, see ya!

**Paimon:** Phew... Paimon's not sure how she found the words to comfort Collei, because honestly, she's kinda nervous herself...

**Paimon:** Let's head to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and see Nahida.

**Khaldun:** Thank you, Sage Baladhuri. You really didn't have to stay with us to the end...

**Baladhuri:** Don't mention it. I'm your teacher, it's my job to look after my students.

**Khaldun:** Is Pania doing okay?

**Baladhuri:** I think so. She just left the city with her mother.

**Baladhuri:** This'll be her first trip away from home. She's handling it much better than I imagined. As her father, it's quite a relief... I just hope they have a smooth trip.

**Baladhuri:** Pack up your things. It's time we got going, too.

**Ruha:** Hey Mister, are you a robot?

**Nawid:** Shh... Look, he's pretending to be human! He definitely doesn't want anyone to find out he's a robot!

**Firnas:** I am a robot.

**Firnas:** I was designed to infiltrate the human world undetected. My mission is to find an opportunity... to destroy humanity.

**Ruha:** I knew it! It's just like in the picture books!

**Nawid:** What do we do? We're the only ones who know his secret, right? Surely he won't... silence us for good?

**Firnas:** You have discovered my secret. Now, I must take you as my prisoners. I will tickle your feet until you join the Robot Army.

**Ruha:** Waaaaaah!

**Nawid:** D—Don't be afraid! I'll protect you. Take this, robot!

**Firnas:** Ow, ow! Stop, stop... I was just kidding! I'm human, I'm human!

**Mu'izz:** *sigh* I can't believe I have to move so far away on such short notice...

**Kashif:** I made an automatic watering device so that my flowers won't wither and die while I'm away from home.

**Mu'izz:** Hey... do you think "renovation works" is the real reason they're moving us to Caravan Ribat?

**Kashif:** There's a rumor going around that Sumeru City's buildings aren't earthquake-resistant enough. Maybe that's it? All we know for sure is that the order came down from the Dendro Archon herself...

**Rima:** Hey, now's not a good time to visit Sumeru City. We're actually getting ready to move out ourselves.

**Tawfiq:** As if work and family aren't enough to deal with already! Now they're telling us to move to Caravan Ribat because of "renovations"? Hmph, I bet it's just some vanity project!

**Tawfiq:** I don't trust the Dendro Archon, nor any of the sages. Especially not that new Grand Sage — what's his name, Naphis? If you ask me, he's the worst of the bunch.

#### Go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana

**Mu'tasim:** Who goes there!? No unauthorized access to this place, by order of Mahamatra Cyno!

**Aarav:** Ahem...

**Aarav:** Are you blind? It's Traveler and Paimon... Surely, you've seen them before?

**Mu'tasim:** Huh? Oh... So it is. I'm sorry, I haven't been sleeping well lately. My nerves are a little frayed.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Not sleeping well, you say?

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** What's troubling you?

##### Shared continuation

**Mu'tasim:** ...The Dendro Archon is in a very vulnerable state at the moment. Mahamatra Cyno is concerned that our enemies might choose this moment to strike, so he's ordered us to strengthen our defenses.

**Aarav:** Just seeing you two again already puts our minds at ease. Please, enter. I'm sure everyone's expecting you.

#### Learn about the situation from everyone

**Cyno:** Traveler, Paimon. You made it.

**Cyrus:** Aha! Perfect timing! Reliable helpers like you are just what we need right now.

**Paimon:** It's good to see everyone again. Collei gave us a rough idea of what's going on, but we still have a lot of questions.

**Paimon:** What kind of danger is Sumeru City in, exactly? And how come everyone has to move to Caravan Ribat?

**Cyrus:** At this stage, we can't be certain. We're investigating, but no definitive answers yet.

**Cyno:** I take it that Collei told you about her strange dream?

**Paimon:** Yeah. Apparently, everyone in Sumeru City was acting super weird. Even you guys. It was like you'd all switched places.

**Cyno:** That's right. Collei and Tighnari reported the situation to the Dendro Archon. She believes that it wasn't merely a dream — and that whatever it was has something to do with Irminsul.

**Cyrus:** It's a reasonable inference. Only through Irminsul can people's memory and cognition be so significantly modified in such a short time.

**Cyno:** We don't know why Collei would dream of these things, nor who was trying to warn her. The Dendro Archon decided to connect to Irminsul to investigate more thoroughly.

- **Traveler:** Has she found anything yet?

**Naphis:** Irminsul is connected directly to the Ley Lines. The tree serves as a central hub where the Ley Lines converge, and its core function is to record and store the world's knowledge and memories.

**Naphis:** But something has gone awry, severely compromising the performance of this core function.

**Naphis:** Information is bottlenecking inside Irminsul, hampering the Ley Lines' flow. If this continues, new information will languish unrecorded, with existing records thrown into disarray.

**Alhaitham:** In short, the souls of the dead will be stranded, while the living have their sense of reality warped.

**Alhaitham:** In the long run, Collei's dream could well become a reality. And that's just the beginning. There's no telling what other nightmares could end up coming true.

- **Traveler:** (Irminsul... the Ley Lines...)

**"The Captain":** I have come this far to use my death to open the gates of the Ley Lines to my people.

- **Traveler:** (In Natlan, The Captain was storing stranded souls inside his own heart. It was only after the rules of the Night Kingdom were amended that they were finally able to return to the Ley Lines...)

- **Traveler:** (And that was just one nation. A problem with Irminsul itself could end up affecting all Ley Lines worldwide...)

**Naphis:** Faced with a growing backlog of information, the Dendro Archon decided to connect herself directly to Irminsul and take over the recording and processing function herself.

**Cyrus:** But it's an almost impossible task. Individual brains aren't equipped to deal with the sheer volume of knowledge and memories involved. All that information flooding in at once would instantly fry any human mind.

**Cyrus:** And for a god... *sigh*. Even for a god, the suffering must be unimaginable.

**Naphis:** The Dendro Archon's power originates from Irminsul. Any issue with the tree itself takes a toll on her to begin with.

**Naphis:** On top of that, she's subjecting herself to the grueling task of processing all that data... It must be torture for her.

**Naphis:** And despite all of this, she is somehow finding the strength to investigate the Irminsul situation from within, and send us her findings...

**[Name]:** I've finished analyzing the latest data. Looks like our working theory was wrong. There's no signs of Irminsul having been attacked from the outside.

**Cyrus:** So it's internal, then? Some sort of disease, perhaps...? Hmm, no... I've spent half my life studying the Ley Lines. If Irminsul malfunctioned this easily, the world would've met its end long ago.

**Cyno:** ...

**Paimon:** Cyno? What is it?

**Cyno:** Not long ago, I got a tip from the Corps of Thirty that a large number of unidentified merchant caravans had recently been spotted entering Sumeru through Bayda Harbor.

**Cyno:** At first, I suspected that they might have something to do with all this, so I sent some people to investigate. But if Irminsul wasn't attacked from the outside...

**[Name]:** Don't you think there are more important things to worry about right now than guessing who's behind all this?

**[Name]:** It's been over twelve hours with no new intel. If even the keeper of Irminsul is this badly affected, you can imagine how bad things are in there.

**Naphis:** Dendro Archon...

**Paimon:** Nahida!

**Cyrus:** What's wrong?

**Naphis:** Her breathing is weak! And her elemental energy levels are dangerously low...

**Alhaitham:** Looks like it's time to move to the backup plan.

**Paimon:** What's the backup plan?
